panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Panel A is T1-weighted breast MRI showing oval low-signal mass described in caption and in-text as mucinous breast cancer; no vocabulary MRI finding for T1 low signal, so captured as proposed finding. B: Panel B is fat-suppressed T2 MRI showing bright high-signal oval breast mass with central lower signal, textbook for mucinous carcinoma extracellular mucin. C: Panel C is subtraction MRI early phase showing rim enhancement of same mucinous breast cancer; rim enhancement not in vocabulary so in proposed_findings; title notes retained rim enhancement suggests aggressive biology, thus atypical. D: Panel D is delayed subtraction MRI showing long-lasting retained rim enhancement of same mucinous breast cancer; not in vocabulary so in proposed_findings; atypical aggressive feature per article title.
